integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof and reproducible finite cross-checks. Computational agreement is not a proof for all orders; the general statement is proved symbolically.
scientific_limitations: The enumeration treats one-leaf coronas of arbitrary finite simple graphs; the specialized optimum counts cover combs and sunlets. Earlier work on some corona scalar restrained-Italian parameters may overlap with scalar corollaries; one directly relevant article was accessible only by abstract, preventing an exhaustive priority conclusion. Nothing establishes independent review or arbitrary-graph computational complexity.
title: A vertex-boundary partition function for restrained Italian domination of leaf coronas
